entities.summary: Frank Meisler was an Israeli architect and sculptor. Meisler was born in the Free City of Danzig and grew up in England, before moving to Israel in 1956. In 1953 he married Batya (Phillis) Hochman with whom he had two daughters: Michal Meisler Yehuda and Marit Meisler. He died in Jaffa in 2018.
